topology.description: Symmetric 2x2 directional coupler with four-lobed butterfly tapering pattern
function: Couples light from two input waveguides into a central interaction region
The taper pairs (top/bottom, left/right) widen from narrow guides into the coupler core
Interaction occurs in the central region where waveguide modes overlap
Light is redistributed symmetrically to two output ports
key_parameters: waveguide_width_um: width of input/output waveguide arms (narrow straight sections)
coupler_width_um: width of the central interaction region (widest part of tapers)
coupler_length_um: length of the central region (controls coupling strength/phase)
taper_length_um: axial length of each taper from narrow to wide
taper_base_y: vertical position of base guides
function_defining_knobs: coupler_width_um — directly controls gap width and mode overlap in interaction region
taper_length_um — taper gradient affects adiabaticity and mode confinement
coupler_length_um — interaction length controls cross-talk and power transfer

structure_outline: Four lobes: top (vertical taper up), bottom (vertical taper down), left (horizontal taper left), right (horizontal taper right)
Central bulge: wider oval region where lobes meet
Input ports: narrow rectangles at cardinal ends of each lobe

primitives: gf.Path for waveguide backbone with width transitions
Bezier or elliptical tapers for smooth mode expansion
Boolean operations to merge components cleanly
implementation_strategy.approach: Build four mirrored taper arms, merge at central region, add straight input guides
